CALLBACK.DSAnPhamQuocTeDetailSummary: DSAnPham[1].map((item,index) => ({...item,  TenLoaiAnPham: item.LoaiAnPhamID === 6 ? item.TenLoaiAnPham + ' quốc tế' : item.TenLoaiAnPham }))
CALLBACK.DSAnPhamTrongNuocDetailSummary: DSAnPham[2].map((item,index) => ({...item,  TenLoaiAnPham: item.LoaiAnPhamID === 6 ? item.TenLoaiAnPham + ' trong nước' : item.TenLoaiAnPham }))

CALLBACK.SoBaiDangTrongNuoc: DSRPT_AnPham.filter(item => item.NoiDangBai === 'Trong nước').reduce((result,item) =>{  if(!result[item.NamDangBai]){     result[item.NamDangBai]=[item]   }else{ result[item.NamDangBai].push(item)  } return result},Object.fromEntries(years.map(y => [y, []])))
